html:
A RABID GUN-GAME...
There is no reloading - Juggle between stolen weaponry and discard empty guns straight into enemy faces! Execute powerful kill animations to regain health and dash across the arena! Combat in REINCARNAGE is a dance of balance where enemies can be both your ammunition, your lifeline and your demise.

...AT THE END OF EARTH.
Pieces of Nilus' story find themselves rooted at the end of it all - REINCARNAGE lays a clearer setting for existing Xentiverse lore while fleshing out the world and characters around it. Peer into the makings of the monster you control and bring the story of the Alterks to a close.
